protocol: fixed cell-level approximately 6:2:2 split on 3804 valid RSRPSet cells
note: The original PEFNet paper reports a 2283/761/761 split for 3805 cells but does not publish the exact CI identities. After strict-outdoor preprocessing one CI has no valid target supervision, leaving 3804 valid cells. We therefore use 2282/761/761 with a fixed deterministic shuffle. The generated CI lists are frozen for all experiments.
